description: Yearly synthetic energy consumption and photovoltaic production profiles for single-family houses in Central Europe Profils synthétiques annuels de consommation énergétique et de production photovoltaïque pour des maison is a data set deposited in inist.osutheta by its authors Mathieu Patin, Sylvie Bégot (Franche-Comté Electronique Mécanique Thermique et Optique - Sciences et Technologies (Université Marie et Loui). The database includes consumption profiles for electricity, heating, hot water and air conditioning, as well as photovoltaic production profiles. The profiles are diverse ((3500 configurations), high-resolution (1-minute time step), continuous (over an entire year) and mutually consistent. Coverage: continental (FR); the metadata date the deposit to 2024. Formats: CSV. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-3.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
